title: Ember Orchard: The Historian's Seed Archive
premise: In a volcanic garden whose fruit germinates in cooling ash, the historian must recover lost testimony without rewriting it using a chronicle decoding slate.
ending: Recover the Seed Archive and return with the unaltered historical account; Orchard Keepers can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive thermal surge while evading the ashwood guardian without sacrificing the unaltered historical account.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Orchard Keepers to witness the chronicle decoding slate.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to reveal a compromising record
